explain plan for
select /* mtk_opt_1111t121257086 nostats_ds */ c.name, n.grp, sum(n.amount)
  from mtk_nostats n join mtk_cust c on c.id = n.cust_id
 where n.grp = 'G3' and c.id < 5000
